title: Increasing Mitochondrial Respiration as a Novel Mechanism for Cognitive Augmentation
official: Increasing Mitochondrial Respiration as a Novel Mechanism for Cognitive Augmentation
summary: The purpose of this study is to investigate the effects of increasing brain energy on cognition. The hypothesis is that by using a special kind of light, in combination with a nutritional supplement, it may be possible to increase energy production in the brain, which may lead to improvements in cognition.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age: 18-85 years old
* No uncorrected visual, auditory, or motor impairments that would interfere with performing cognitive tasks

Exclusion Criteria:

* Transcranial photobiomodulation in the last six weeks
* Diabetes
* Pregnancy or plans to become pregnant
* Breastfeeding or plans to breastfeed
* Major depressive disorder
* Psychotic disorders
* Suicidal ideation within the past 6 months
* Plans for serious medical procedures in the next 3 months
* Serious hepatic or liver-related conditions
* History of neurotrauma (e.g., brain lesions or traumatic brain injury)
* Presently on a ketogenic diet
